label: Claude with Chisle
install: set -e; mkdir -p ~/.local; curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.12.0/node-v22.12.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C ~/.local --strip-components=1; curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash; claude plugin marketplace add JayPokale/Chisle; claude plugin install chisle@chisle
fired: any(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init" and ((.plugins // []) | any(.name == "chisle"))) and any(.type == "result" and (.is_error | not))
